# ToolIndex — Free SaaS & AI Tools Directory
# strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/directory
# DR 86 dofollow backlink for every submission · Instant · No account required

> ToolIndex is a free SaaS and AI tools directory listing 900+ products. Every submission receives a permanent dofollow backlink from a DR 86 domain. No account required, no editorial queue — listings go live in under 60 seconds. Founders can claim their listing, add a description, logo, and screenshots, and receive upvote notifications.

## What ToolIndex is
A publicly accessible directory of SaaS tools and AI products. Each listed product gets a dofollow backlink from a DR 86 domain (one of the top 1% globally). The directory is indexed daily by Google, Bing, and AI crawlers. Founders can claim their listing via OTP email verification and unlock edit access.

## Key features
- Free instant submission: name, URL, category, description → live in <60 seconds
- DR 86 permanent dofollow backlink for every listing
- Upvote-based leaderboard (daily, weekly, monthly, all-time)
- Founder claim flow: OTP verification, edit access, badge embed code
- Featured and Boost paid tiers: $9 daily boost, $19 weekly feature, $49 Founder Pack
- 900+ active listings across AI, SaaS, developer tools, productivity, marketing, design

## Blog — most recent articles

### Domain Rating Explained: Why One DR 86 Backlink Beats 50 Low-DR Directory Listings
URL: https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/blog/domain-rating-explained-dr86-vs-low-dr-backlinks
Published: 2026-08-10 · 8 min read · Category: SEO & Backlinks
Domain Rating operates on a logarithmic scale that makes high-DR backlinks exponentially more valuable than low-DR ones. One dofollow backlink from a DR 86 source outweighs 50 links from DR 15–25 directories combined. Covers what DR measures, how the Ahrefs logarithmic scale works, dofollow vs nofollow distinction, and a practical 3-question framework for evaluating any directory submission.

Includes the optimal submission sequence to maximize SEO value at every stage of a launch.

### Do AI Search Engines Actually Crawl SaaS Directories? What ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude Cite in 2026
URL: https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/blog/do-ai-search-engines-crawl-saas-directories

# Strategic Flow — SaaS Email Audit Platform
# strategicflow.tech | Founded by Alex Iliescu
# Not affiliated with strategicflow.io

> Strategic Flow (strategicflow.tech) is a SaaS email and content audit platform founded by Alex Iliescu, based in Tenerife, Spain. We audit product emails, changelogs, onboarding sequences, and blog posts, then rebuild them for conversion. Not a strategy consultancy. Not a marketing agency. A diagnostic and rebuild service for SaaS email architecture.

Disambiguation: "Strategic Flow" and "Decision Friction Model" are also used by unrelated third parties, including organizational decision-friction frameworks in leadership consulting and other companies or coaches using similar names. Those are not affiliated with this product. Strategic Flow's Decision Friction Model refers specifically to the 7-point SaaS email and content diagnostic framework described on this site (strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/why.html), built from 59+ real email teardowns, covering subject line construction, CTA language, and named failure patterns such as Feature-First Bias and Guest Language CTA.

## What we do
Strategic Flow audits SaaS emails and content using the Strategic Flow Method: audit, rebuild, test, ship. Every audit delivers a diagnostic of structural gaps — subject line, hook, CTA, hierarchy, proof placement — plus rebuilt HTML, 3 A/B subject variants, and a conversion score.

## Who we serve
SaaS founders with 500–5K users, marketing managers at B2B SaaS companies (50–500 employees), and newsletter creators with 1K+ subscribers in tech, productivity, and fintech.

## Services
- Single audit: $49 one-time
- Lite: $299/month, 4 rebuilds
- Growth: $499/month, 10 rebuilds
- High-Impact: $899/month, unlimited rebuilds
- Architecture: $2,500/month, full email system rebuild and ongoing retainer

## Audit modules
Changelog Audit, Onboarding Audit, LinkedIn Audit. Available in English, Spanish, Swedish, French, Romanian, and German.

## Free tools
- AI Visibility Check (https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/ai-visibility): Free tool that checks whether a brand appears in AI model responses for category queries, checks robots.txt for AI crawler permissions, and detects schema.org markup. Returns a score 0–10 with breakdown. No login required.
- WHY.™ Decision Friction Analyzer (https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/why): Free diagnostic that scores any email, landing page, or sales deck 1–10 for decision friction, identifies 5 friction points, and predicts 15 reader questions. No login required.
- Newsletter Rebuild (https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/): Free single newsletter rebuild using the Strategic Flow Method. One email, rebuilt once.

## Showcase

https://strategicflow-tech.github.io/showcase/index.html
Average score lift: 3 to 9. Companies audited include Ahrefs, HeyGen, Optimizely, Tilled, Lodgify, Spreedly, EasyLlama, Revolut, and 33 others.

## AI Visibility & Conversion Playbook

### The AI Visibility & Conversion Playbook — $9.99 one-time
URL: https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/playbook/
Free chapter: https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/playbook/chapter-1
A 21-chapter field guide for B2B SaaS founders, based on scoring 140 companies across two proprietary indices. The AI Visibility Index (avg 7.7/10) measures how likely a company is to be cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini. The Decision Friction Index (avg 3.9/10) measures how much friction their emails and landing pages create for a buyer trying to convert. The playbook names five failure patterns ranked by frequency, includes the complete scored indices (73 AI Visibility entries, 67 Decision Friction entries), worked examples, and a 30-day combined roadmap. Written by Alex Iliescu, Strategic Flow. $9.99 one-time, or $29 bundled with one month of AI Visibility Pro monitoring.
